zh-CN.eyebrow: 面向文档交付的桌面工具
zh-CN.title: 从 Markdown 出发，完成可重复的文档交付。
zh-CN.description: FloraDoc 将 Markdown、样式与模板、桌面工作区和命令行工具连接起来，让文档生成过程清晰、可检查、可复用。
zh-CN.intro: 围绕一份可读、可维护的 Markdown 源文件，组织文档构建、工具执行、资源和运行记录。
zh-CN.workflowTitle: 让文件保持清晰，让交付过程可追踪
zh-CN.workflowBody: 以工作区中的 Markdown、样式与模板作为输入，通过 FloraDoc 桌面应用或 CLI 运行构建，并查看结构化结果。
zh-CN.screenshotCaption: 来自 FloraDoc 桌面应用的真实界面截图。
zh-CN.screenshotPendingBody: 正式产品截图尚未收录。我们会在确认当前版本界面后补充。
zh-CN.releaseBody: 公开发行包与校验信息准备就绪后，将在这里提供下载。
zh-CN.docsBody: 面向用户的正式使用文档正在整理中。内部设计与开发资料不会作为公开文档发布。
zh-CN.supportBody: 公开反馈渠道尚未配置。发布前会补充可用的支持入口。

features.title: 以 Markdown 组织内容
features.summary: 将 Markdown 文件作为文档构建输入，保留源文件与本地图片资源的文件路径。

features.title: 生成 Word 与 Excel 文档
features.summary: 使用样式资源将 Markdown 构建为 DOCX 或 XLSX，并生成结构化构建和运行报告。

features.title: 复用样式与 Word 模板
features.summary: 从资源目录选择样式与受支持的原生 DOCX 模板；XLSX 原生模板适配目前不支持。

features.title: 项目工作区与资源管理
features.summary: 通过桌面端或 CLI 创建、检查和校验文档项目；管理模板、样例、文档、图片和附件目录。

features.title: 工具与流程执行
features.summary: 按 Manifest 调用工具，也可执行带输入、步骤和输出映射的工作流。

features.title: DOCX 提取、重建与比较
features.summary: 可提取文档模型、语义重建、恢复原包并生成比较报告；不支持或未评估的结构会单独诊断。

features.title: PowerPoint 构建
features.summary: 已有 Markdown 到 PPTX 的模板与页面构建链路；整体视觉验收仍需完成，因此目前列为实验性。

scenarios.title: 样式化技术文档
scenarios.body: 从 Markdown 和样式资源生成一致的 DOCX 文档。

scenarios.title: 结构化表格输出
scenarios.body: 将 Markdown 内容按已配置格式输出为 XLSX 工作簿。

scenarios.title: 可复查的自动化构建
scenarios.body: 通过 CLI 或流程描述文件执行工具，并查看每一步的状态与产物报告。

faqs.question: 现在可以下载 FloraDoc 吗？
faqs.answer: 公开 Release 仓与正式安装包尚未建立。下载入口会在真实版本发布后开放；目前页面不会显示虚构的文件或校验值。

faqs.question: 支持哪些系统？
faqs.answer: 当前可核实的发布目标为 Windows x64。正式版本发布时会公布具体系统版本要求。

faqs.question: 可以把 DOCX 完整往返还原吗？
faqs.answer: DOCX 工具会标记不支持或未评估的结构。语义重建与原包恢复是不同操作，不能据此承诺任意文档都能无损往返。

faqs.question: PPTX 构建已经正式支持了吗？
faqs.answer: 构建链路已实现，但整体视觉验收尚未完成，因此网站将其标为实验性功能。

faqs.question: 如何安装 FloraDoc？
faqs.answer: 公开安装包尚未发布。正式发行后，下载中心会标明文件类型、系统要求和安装说明；当前不会提供占位文件。

faqs.question: 可以处理哪些文件格式？
faqs.answer: 当前有 Markdown 输入与 DOCX、XLSX 输出能力。原生 XLSX 模板适配尚不支持；PPTX 构建目前仍属实验性。

faqs.question: 如何校验下载文件？
faqs.answer: 正式版本会显示每个发行文件的 SHA-256。下载后可在 Windows PowerShell 使用 Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 <文件路径>，并与页面值核对。

faqs.question: 如何获取更新？
faqs.answer: 正式稳定版发布后，下载中心会展示版本号、发行日期、更新摘要和真实文件。也可以在发行记录中查看历史版本。

faqs.question: 遇到问题时在哪里反馈？
faqs.answer: 公开反馈渠道尚未配置。反馈入口会在确认可用后添加到网站。

en.eyebrow: A desktop workspace for document delivery
en.title: Start with Markdown. Deliver documents you can review and repeat.
en.description: FloraDoc brings Markdown, styles and templates, a desktop workspace, and command-line tools into a clear, reusable document workflow.
en.intro: Organize document builds, tool runs, resources, and reports around readable Markdown source files.
en.workflowTitle: Keep the files clear. Make the process traceable.
en.workflowBody: Build from Markdown and selected styles or templates in a workspace, run the process through FloraDoc Desktop or the CLI, then inspect structured results.
en.screenshotCaption: A genuine screenshot from the FloraDoc desktop application.
en.screenshotPendingBody: An approved product screenshot has not been added yet. We will add one after confirming the current application version.
en.releaseBody: Downloads and checksums will appear here when an official release is ready.
en.docsBody: Public user documentation is being prepared. Internal design and development material will not be published as user guidance.
en.supportBody: A public support channel has not been configured yet. A verified contact option will be added before release.

features.title: Markdown as the content source
features.summary: Build from Markdown files while keeping source documents and local image assets as regular files.

features.title: Word and Excel output
features.summary: Build DOCX or XLSX files from Markdown and style resources, with structured build and run reports.

features.title: Reusable styles and Word templates
features.summary: Select styles and supported native DOCX templates from the resource catalog. Native XLSX template adapters are not currently supported.

features.title: Project workspace and resources
features.summary: Create, inspect, and validate document projects through Desktop or CLI, with directories for templates, examples, documents, images, and attachments.

features.title: Tools and workflow execution
features.summary: Run tools through manifests and execute workflows with mapped inputs, steps, and outputs.

features.title: DOCX extraction, rebuild, and comparison
features.summary: Extract a document model, rebuild semantically, restore the original package, and produce comparison reports. Unsupported or unevaluated structures are diagnosed.

features.title: PowerPoint builds
features.summary: A Markdown-to-PPTX template and page-build path is implemented. Full visual acceptance is still pending, so this capability is experimental.

scenarios.title: Styled technical documents
scenarios.body: Generate consistent DOCX files from Markdown and style resources.

scenarios.title: Structured spreadsheet output
scenarios.body: Map Markdown content into XLSX workbooks using configured format files.

scenarios.title: Reviewable automation
scenarios.body: Run tools from the CLI or workflow manifests and inspect each step and its output report.

faqs.question: Can I download FloraDoc today?
faqs.answer: The public release repository and official installer are not available yet. Downloads will appear after a real release; this site will not show invented files or checksums.

faqs.question: Which systems are supported?
faqs.answer: The currently documented package target is Windows x64. Exact Windows version requirements will be published with a stable release.

faqs.question: Can every DOCX round-trip without loss?
faqs.answer: The DOCX tools report structures that are unsupported or not evaluated. Semantic rebuild and package restore are separate operations, so lossless round-trip behavior is not promised for every document.

faqs.question: Is PPTX generation officially supported?
faqs.answer: The build path is implemented, but full visual acceptance is incomplete. The site labels it experimental.

faqs.question: How do I install FloraDoc?
faqs.answer: An official installer has not been published. Once a release is available, the download center will show the file type, system requirements, and installation guidance. No placeholder file is offered.

faqs.question: Which file formats can FloraDoc handle?
faqs.answer: The current workflow accepts Markdown and can build DOCX and XLSX files. Native XLSX template adapters are not supported yet; PPTX builds remain experimental.

faqs.question: How do I verify a download?
faqs.answer: Each published file will have a SHA-256 value. After downloading on Windows, run Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 <file-path> in PowerShell and compare the result with the value on the site.

faqs.question: How do I get updates?
faqs.answer: After an official stable version is released, the download center will show its version, date, summary, and real files. The release history lists earlier versions.

faqs.question: Where can I report a problem?
faqs.answer: A public feedback channel has not been configured yet. A verified contact option will be added when available.
